final_solver: LSODA with terminal volume event and feed-off coast phase
search_note: Completed volume-constrained searches were reused; duplicate candidates from RHS-stop and event-based searches were all replayed with the final event model, and the highest product retained per case. All runs use seed 42 and the same DE budget. Rankings remain exploratory.
pulse_note: Pulsed candidates were replayed with max step <=0.01 h and <=one eighth of the shortest on/off interval. Halving that step changed totals by less than 0.15%. Pulsed parameter searches used the earlier coarser integration; repeated optimization on the refined integration is still needed.
